summary: Shoshone County, Idaho lookout on the St. Joe National Forest: camp in 1926, L-4 cab in 1935, destroyed in 1953. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1953; no source describes what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as a hike-in

evidence.supports: Shoshone County Beaver Peak entry 1: ground lookout, status gone (not tied to this lookout by coordinates)
Shoshone County Beaver Peak entry 2: tower gone, coordinates differ from entry 1

notes_for_editor: Dates trace to the Kresek data via Forest Lookouts; the other three sites repeat them, so they are not independent. The FFLA list carries a second Beaver Peak in Shoshone County (47.98720, -116.17042, Tower Gone); its Idaho Fire Lookouts page (cda-region/beaver-peak/) is a different tower and was not used. No photos found. The brief's status gone, design L-4 and 1953 destroyed match all sources, so no corrections proposed. None of the first three sources gives coordinates for this lookout, so the story no longer assigns either FFLA Beaver Peak entry to it.
